data.name: Bare Boat Rental - Speed Boat Tour
data.headline: 2 Hours • Up to 8 people
data.description:
### Want a high speed thrill but don't want to operate a powerboat rental boat yourself?

#Pick up locations
- Paradise Point Resort & Spa (RECOMENDED): 1404 W Vacation Way

- Bahia Resort: 998 W Mission Bay Dr

- Catamaran Resort: 3981 W Mission Bay Blvd

Up to 8 passengers.
- Driver must be paid cash at the rate of $50 an hour 
- Feel free to bring your own food, snacks and beverages. (No glass)

data.booking_notes:
#We look forward to you joining us!

Important information to know before your rental:

1. Please arrive 15 minutes prior to your reservation start time. Your rental duration starts at the time of your reservation.
2. Complete the online waiver in this confirmation email prior to arrival.
3. Bring the credit card that was used to make the reservation and the matching drivers license/ID.

Here is a list of guides to choose from:
1. Jane Yarbrough
2. Jacob Steevens
3. Ryan Gilligan
4. Joe Tucker
5. Collin Hilliard
